# ConversionBridge

Privacy-First Server-Side Conversion Tracking for Meta Ads & Google Analytics 4.

--- ## 📌 Executive Summary **ConversionBridge** is an enterprise-grade, open-source Python and Firebase solution for capturing consent-aware first-party conversion events and dispatching them directly to **Meta Conversions API (CAPI)** and **Google Analytics 4 (GA4) Measurement Protocol** via server-to-server integrations. Modern performance marketing suffers from severe signal degradation caused by iOS App Tracking Transparency (ATT), browser ad-blockers, ITP cookie lifespan caps, and third-party cookie restrictions. Browser-only tracking routinely misses **15% to 30% of conversions**, distorting return on ad spend (ROAS) and crippling algorithmic bidding. ConversionBridge restores measurement integrity by moving conversion delivery to a trusted, secure first-party server environment—enforcing user consent, eliminating duplicate transactions, and protecting customer privacy. --- ## 🏗️ System Architecture ```mermaid flowchart TD subgraph Clients["First-Party Client Applications"] Web["Web Application / Checkout"] Backend["E-Commerce / CRM Server"] Mobile["Mobile App Backend"] end subgraph Gateway["ConversionBridge Gateway (FastAPI / Firebase Functions v2)"] Ingest["POST /api/v1/events"] AuthRate["Authentication & Sliding-Window Rate Limiting"] Validate["Event Validator (Timestamps, Schema, Data Formats)"] Consent["Consent Engine (Fail-Closed Policy)"] Dedup["Deduplication Engine (48-Hour Idempotency)"] Storage[("Storage Backend\nMemory / Cloud Firestore")] end subgraph Destinations["Advertising & Measurement Platforms"] Meta["Meta Conversions API\nGraph API v20.0"] GA4["Google Analytics 4\nMeasurement Protocol"] end Web -->|Conversion Event| Ingest Backend -->|Purchase / CRM Deal| Ingest Mobile -->|In-App Conversion| Ingest Ingest --> AuthRate AuthRate --> Validate Validate --> Consent Consent -->|Consent Permitted| Dedup Consent -.->|Consent Denied| BlockedConsent["Log Skipped (Consent)"] Dedup <--> Storage Dedup -->|Unique Event| Dispatcher["Multi-Channel Dispatcher"] Dedup -.->|Duplicate ID| BlockedDedup["Suppress Duplicate"] Dispatcher -->|SHA-256 Hashed Customer Signals| Meta Dispatcher -->|Client ID & Event Parameters| GA4 ``` --- ## ✨ Key Capabilities - **Unified Multi-Channel Gateway**: Ingests a single standardized first-party event and dispatches to Meta CAPI, GA4, or both in parallel. - **Fail-Closed Consent Architecture**: Gated by explicit consent flags (`consent.advertising` for Meta, `consent.analytics` for GA4).
